classes.name: Healthy
descriptions: The ER-16K rolling bearing is healthy without a localized defect.
The vibration remains stable and lacks persistent bearing characteristic-frequency impacts.
No inner-race, outer-race, rolling-element, or compound defect is present.

symptoms.name: Stable vibration
symptoms.description: The vibration amplitude is stable without a repeating train of localized impacts.

symptoms.name: No characteristic-frequency peak
symptoms.description: No persistent envelope-spectrum peak is associated with a bearing characteristic frequency.

symptoms.name: Low impulsiveness
symptoms.description: The signal has low impulsiveness and lacks defect-induced resonance bursts.

classes.name: InnerRace_Medium
descriptions: The bearing has a medium inner-race defect with an approximately 0.15 mm seeded damage size.
The signal contains moderate repeated impacts near the inner-race ball-pass frequency.
Shaft-rotation modulation may occur because the inner-race defect moves through the load zone.

symptoms.name: Moderate BPFI impact train
symptoms.description: Moderate repeated impacts occur near BPFI and its harmonics.

symptoms.name: Moderate rotational sidebands
symptoms.description: BPFI components show moderate sidebands related to shaft rotation.

symptoms.name: Moderate inner-race resonance
symptoms.description: Inner-race impacts excite moderate high-frequency resonance bursts.

classes.name: InnerRace_Severe
descriptions: The bearing has a severe inner-race defect with an approximately 0.30 mm seeded damage size.
The vibration exhibits strong BPFI-related impacts and shaft-rotation modulation.
Severe inner-race damage produces pronounced impulsiveness and resonance excitation.

symptoms.name: Strong BPFI impact train
symptoms.description: Strong repeated impacts occur near BPFI and multiple harmonics.

symptoms.name: Strong rotational sidebands
symptoms.description: BPFI harmonics exhibit pronounced shaft-frequency sidebands.

symptoms.name: Strong inner-race resonance
symptoms.description: Severe inner-race impacts excite strong high-frequency resonance bursts.

classes.name: OuterRace_Medium
descriptions: The bearing has a medium outer-race defect with an approximately 0.15 mm seeded damage size.
The stationary outer-race defect produces moderate periodic impacts near BPFO.
The impact amplitude is comparatively stable because the defect remains at a fixed location.

symptoms.name: Moderate BPFO impact train
symptoms.description: Moderate repeated impacts occur near BPFO and its harmonics.

symptoms.name: Moderate stationary impacts
symptoms.description: The outer-race impact train has a moderately stable amplitude pattern.

symptoms.name: Moderate outer-race resonance
symptoms.description: Outer-race impacts excite moderate high-frequency resonance bursts.

classes.name: OuterRace_Severe
descriptions: The bearing has a severe outer-race defect with an approximately 0.30 mm seeded damage size.
The vibration contains strong periodic BPFO-related impacts.
Severe outer-race damage produces pronounced stationary impact and resonance patterns.

symptoms.name: Strong BPFO impact train
symptoms.description: Strong repeated impacts occur near BPFO and multiple harmonics.

symptoms.name: Strong stationary impacts
symptoms.description: The stationary outer-race defect produces a strong and regular impact-amplitude pattern.

symptoms.name: Strong outer-race resonance
symptoms.description: Severe outer-race impacts excite strong high-frequency resonance bursts.

classes.name: Ball_Medium
descriptions: The bearing has a medium rolling-element defect with an approximately 0.25 mm seeded damage size.
The signal contains moderate components near the ball spin frequency.
Impact amplitude varies as the damaged rolling element enters and leaves the load zone.

symptoms.name: Moderate ball-spin components
symptoms.description: Moderate spectral components occur near the ball spin frequency and its harmonics.

symptoms.name: Moderate load-zone modulation
symptoms.description: Ball-spin components show moderate modulation as the damaged ball crosses the load zone.

symptoms.name: Moderate irregular impacts
symptoms.description: The rolling-element defect produces moderately irregular impact intervals.

classes.name: Ball_Severe
descriptions: The bearing has a severe rolling-element defect with an approximately 0.50 mm seeded damage size.
The signal exhibits strong ball-spin components and load-zone modulation.
Severe rolling-element damage produces pronounced irregular impacts and resonance excitation.

symptoms.name: Strong ball-spin components
symptoms.description: Strong spectral components occur near the ball spin frequency and multiple harmonics.

symptoms.name: Strong load-zone modulation
symptoms.description: Ball-spin components show strong modulation related to load-zone motion.

symptoms.name: Strong irregular impacts
symptoms.description: Severe rolling-element damage produces strong non-stationary impact intervals.

classes.name: Compound_Medium
descriptions: The bearing has simultaneous medium inner-race and outer-race defects.
The vibration contains both moderate BPFI-related and BPFO-related impact components.
The compound defect produces mixed modulation and resonance evidence from both raceways.

symptoms.name: Moderate compound BPFI components
symptoms.description: Moderate inner-race characteristic-frequency impacts are present in the compound fault.

symptoms.name: Moderate compound BPFO components
symptoms.description: Moderate outer-race characteristic-frequency impacts are present in the compound fault.

symptoms.name: Moderate mixed resonance
symptoms.description: The combined raceway impacts excite moderate mixed high-frequency resonance bursts.

classes.name: Compound_Severe
descriptions: The bearing has simultaneous severe inner-race and outer-race defects.
The vibration contains strong BPFI-related and BPFO-related impact components.
The severe compound defect produces pronounced mixed modulation, impulsiveness, and resonance evidence.

symptoms.name: Strong compound BPFI components
symptoms.description: Strong inner-race characteristic-frequency impacts are present in the compound fault.

symptoms.name: Strong compound BPFO components
symptoms.description: Strong outer-race characteristic-frequency impacts are present in the compound fault.

symptoms.name: Strong mixed resonance
symptoms.description: The combined severe raceway impacts excite strong mixed high-frequency resonance bursts.
